name: jazzy-2026.10.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Remove trailing spaces (#401). by @ivanperez-keera in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/402
* Bump actions/checkout to v7 (#406). by @dvadovsz in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/405
* Reduce core image size (#356) by @henrygerardmoore in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/357
* Replace Earthly with Docker Buildx for Space ROS builds (#107) by @JWhitleyWork in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/388
* Update `run.sh` to quote shell variables (#428). by @ivanperez-keera in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/429
* Pin Docker build runners to ubuntu-24.04 (#432) by @dvadovsz in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/433
* Update versions of `actions/upload-artifact` and `docker/login-action` (#414) by @dvadovsz in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/426
* Add a `build.sh` entry point for the Space ROS image (#410). by @dvadovsz in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/427
* Add `rosinstall_generator` to the `main`, `dev` images (#413). by @dvadovsz in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/425
* Make `rosdeps.sh` fail if any system package fails to install with `apt-get` by @dvadovsz in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/423
* Build main image on arm64 (#171) by @dvadovsz in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/431
* Update repos for `jazzy-2026.10.0` (#437). by @ivanperez-keera in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/446

## New Contributors
* @dvadovsz made their first contribution in https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/pull/405

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/space-ros/space-ros/compare/jazzy-2026.07.0...jazzy-2026.10.0
